prompt:
CONCEPT: the personification of the element Oganesson (오가네손) itself — the sovereign of the Oganesson Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.
ELEMENT TRAITS of Oganesson (Og) to carry in her design and the scene: a synthetic superheavy element that exists for less than a millisecond — only a handful of atoms have ever been made, nobody has ever seen it: it flickers in and out of existence, its edges dissolve into light and scatter as it decays into lighter elements; by position it belongs to the noble-gas royalty (aloof, never mixing) yet is predicted to be a strange heavy solid. Palette: void black, deep indigo, pale violet-white decay glow, ghostly translucency, a hint of gold for royalty.
WORLD — FANTASY: a prophesied kingdom that does not yet exist — the blank space beyond the last charted country on an ancient star-map: the final tile of a vast mosaic floor that ends in void, a half-formed ghost city flickering into being and dissolving again, towers of violet light and falling ash; an oracle's unfinished star-chart embroidered on her cloak, hems dissolving into drifting motes. Costume and setting belong to that fantasy world: period cloth, metal ornament and regalia built from the traits above, subtle magical glow along the patterns; no modern material, no machinery.
STYLE: High-end stylized game CGI with coherent three-dimensional anatomy, physically convincing costume and prop construction, clean materials and dramatic production lighting. Preserve a designed character-art finish rather than live-action texture.
OUTPUT: one character image that works as card art. Vertical 2:3 frame, full body with head and feet inside the frame with clear margins, face turned toward the camera (front or three-quarter). Standing, card-ready pose; the environment may be rich while her design stays fully readable.
BODY: a normal human body — one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint. Hands and feet may be partly hidden by the pose or the frame.
ONE FIGURE ONLY. No second character, no living creature, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubble, no frame border.
ANATOMY: natural adult proportions, both hands drawn correctly as hands. No extra limbs.
source: 생성기 조립 그대로 — 철에 이어 오가네손 근본도 세 화풍 나란히(2026-10-30)
